name: urbancandy-monorepo
description: Monorepo for UrbanCandy project (Backend, Frontend, AI)

scripts.lint:check: npm --prefix UrbanCandy_back run lint:check && npm --prefix UrbanCandy_front run lint:check
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix UrbanCandy_back run format:check && npm --prefix UrbanCandy_front run format:check
scripts.pre-pr-check: npm run lint:check && npm run format:check && npm run test:back && npm run test:front
scripts.test:e2e:ci: start-server-and-test "npm --prefix UrbanCandy_back run test:server" http://localhost:3000 "npm --prefix UrbanCandy_front run test:e2e"
